Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.namespace

Class NamespaceManager

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.AbstractManager
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.api.namespace.NamespaceManager
public class NamespaceManager extends AbstractManager
GeoServer Namespace REST API client.

A namespace identifies the XML/URI namespace associated with a workspace. Each namespace has a short prefix (matching the workspace name) and a URI. Namespaces and workspaces share a strict 1:1 relationship: creating a namespace also creates the paired workspace, and deleting one removes the other.

Endpoints

 GET     /rest/namespaces/{prefix}
 PUT     /rest/namespaces/{prefix}
 DELETE  /rest/namespaces/{prefix}

    • list

      public List<NamespaceSummary> list()
      Returns all namespaces (summary: name + href only).

      GeoServer returns {"namespaces":""} when there are no namespaces; this method normalizes that to an empty list.

      Returns:
      list of namespace summaries, never null

    • create

      public Namespace create(CreateNamespaceRequest request)
      Creates a namespace. A workspace with the same prefix is automatically created.

      Note: GeoServer 2.28.2 returns 500 (not 409) for duplicate prefixes; the response body is inspected to detect this case.

      Parameters:
      request - creation parameters (required)
      Returns:
      the created namespace (via GET after POST)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if request or prefix/uri is null/empty
      ResourceAlreadyExistsException - if a namespace with the same prefix already exists

    • update

      public Namespace update(String prefix, UpdateNamespaceRequest request)
      Updates a namespace. Only uri and isolated can be changed.

      The prefix is immutable — do not include it in UpdateNamespaceRequest.

      Parameters:
      prefix - current namespace prefix (required)
      request - update parameters (uri/isolated fields)
      Returns:
      the updated namespace (via GET after PUT)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if prefix is null/empty or request is null
      NamespaceNotFoundException - if no namespace with the given prefix exists

    • delete

      public void delete(String prefix)
      Deletes a namespace. The paired workspace is also deleted.
      Parameters:
      prefix - namespace prefix (required)
      Throws:
      InvalidParameterException - if prefix is null or empty
      NamespaceNotFoundException - if no namespace with the given prefix exists (404)
      GeoServerResponseException - if the namespace has associated resources (403)
